runtime.entrypoint: JSON {id: providerJobId, input: job} on stdin; one redacted JSON result on stdout
runtime.mount: Optional /banks read-only: <avatarSha256>.tar and <bankReceiptSha256>.json; bankDownload capabilities may instead populate a verified ephemeral /tmp cache
runtime.protocol: Existing pong/start/PCM/end/lapp/done plus mandatory pong.attestation and exact bind acknowledgement and per-chunk id/del ack (15s bound)
runtime.rendering: 24fps, 220ms leading and 530ms trailing silence, 12-frame chunks; one utterance/job
runtime.admission: Game server and budget journal own authorization, reservation, accepted provider job and finalization

bankDownload.origin: HTTPS with callback hostname and effective port; no redirects/proxies
bankDownload.cache: Hash-addressed /tmp/croupier-moving-banks, reverified on every hit; corrupt entries fail closed
bankDownload.credentials: Only job-bound capability URLs; no general Blob or provider key

notes: build.py never pushes or creates cloud resources.
Use a full verified prepared bank, not the shortened offline preview bank.
Measured throughput below 30fps fails admission; no MIN_RUTOR=0 override.

aptBootstrap.verification: Ubuntu archive keyring verified InRelease -> SHA256 Packages.xz -> SHA256 deb; BuildKit ADD verifies the locked package before extraction

verificationRequirements.containerBuild: External CI receipt for this exact release and serverless target, including CPU imports and tests; no image publication implied
verificationRequirements.gpuRuntime: External GPU receipt for this exact release, image digest and verified bank; include latency and cancellation
verificationRequirements.liveGame: External authenticated session and budget/finalization receipt for this exact release and image digest
verificationRequirements.visualApproval: Separate acceptance tied to exact source, audio and generated video hashes; tests alone do not establish lip sync
